h1: Review of the Top 10 Course Selling Apps in India (2026): Ranked by Use Case, Prices Checked
dek: Ten apps Indian educators use to sell courses, ranked against five criteria anyone can check, with every price taken from the official site and dated, and a clear pick for each kind of educator.
cover_alt: Which course selling app is right for you: top 10 course selling apps in India ranked by use case, prices checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian educators, tutors and coaching institutes choosing an app to sell online courses
intro: The best course selling app in India depends on what you sell: for your own website and Android and iOS app built yourself, AllCoaching; for test series, Learnyst; for sessions with nothing paid upfront, Exly; for training businesses with branches, Edmingle; and for one flat yearly price at higher sales, Classplus. We ranked ten apps against five criteria you can check on each official website, and every price below is from that site, checked on 24 Oct 2026.

We are AllCoaching and our app is in this list, ranked first on our own criteria. Weigh that. We publish the criteria and the score for each app so you can reweight them: if paying nothing before your first sale matters most to you, Exly ranks higher; if mock tests are your whole business, Learnyst does.
This 2026 update also drops apps from last year's list that no longer stand as separate course-selling products, and explains why.
takeaways: Five criteria, all checkable: rupee price published, fee on sales stated, own domain plus Android and iOS app at entry, start without a sales call, built for Indian educators.
Top picks by use case: AllCoaching (own website and app), Learnyst (test series), Exly (no upfront fee), Edmingle (branches), Classplus (flat yearly price).
AllCoaching is one predictable annual plan from ₹6,999 plus 10%, 7.5% or 5% only when you sell; GST extra; 14-day free trial, no card.
Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year; GST, any fee on sales and renewal price are not stated on its page (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Graphy's rupee prices could not be confirmed on 24 Oct 2026, and Spayee's website now redirects to Graphy.
Udemy is a marketplace, not an app you run; its revenue share could not be verified on its own page, so we do not quote one.

sections.h2: How we ranked the top 10 course selling apps
sections.html:
We scored each app against five criteria that matter to an Indian educator selling their own courses, using only what each company publishes on its own website.

  1. Rupee price published, so you can see the cost before talking to anyone.
  2. Fee on sales stated, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. Own domain and own Android and iOS app on the entry plan, so students remember your brand.
  4. Start without a sales call: a free trial, a no-upfront-fee plan or free sign-up.
  5. Built for Indian educators: rupee pricing and courses for Indian students.

Apps are ordered by score, then by how many kinds of educators they serve. These criteria are our choice; a different reader might weigh price before the first sale or test-series depth more heavily, and the order would change.

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: The top 10 course selling apps in India, reviewed
sections.html:
Each app below is described the way its own company describes it, with the published price, what to check and the use case it suits best. The score is the number of our five criteria it meets on its own website.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching · meets 5 of 5

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: sign up, choose a plan, upload your course, connect your domain and start selling. Website on your own domain, your own Android and iOS app, courses, tests, PDF notes, unlimited live classes and UPI checkout.
Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%; GST extra; 14-day free trial, no card.[1]
Check
At very small sales, a no-upfront-fee app costs less; above about ₹2.3 lakh a year, Classplus's flat listed price is lower on paper.
Best for
Educators and institutes who want their own website and app, built themselves.

2. Learnyst · meets 4 of 5

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with content protection and test series; it pitches "Features required to market and sell your content online across globe".
Published price
Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10% of sales; Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099 billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; higher plans up to ₹49,999/month; taxes extra.[2]
Check
Branded Android from Premium, branded iOS from Business, published under Learnyst's developer account.
Best for
Test series for NEET, JEE, SSC and banking exams.

3. Exly · meets 4 of 5

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches selling courses, consultations and digital products; "an all-in-one solution to all things business".
Published price
Starter: no upfront fee + 10% commission; Pro ₹30,000/yr + 6%; Premium ₹1,08,000/yr + 3%.[3]
Check
A mobile app is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year; GST and a trial are not stated.
Best for
Coaches selling sessions, cohorts or digital products with nothing paid upfront.

4. Edmingle · meets 3 of 5

Good at
An "AI-powered LMS purpose-built for professional training and skilling businesses", with batches, branches and white-labelled academies.
Published price
Core ₹7,499/month, Prime ₹14,999/month, Power ₹29,999/month, billed annually; taxes extra; 7-day free start.[4]
Check
Fee on sales not stated; branded Android from Prime, branded iOS from Power.
Best for
Training businesses and institutes with several batches or branches.

5. TagMango · meets 3 of 5

Good at
Courses, community and automation for coaches, with an AI add-on stack and optional branded apps.
Published price
Basic: no fixed fee + 10% (up to 200 students); Pro ₹5,000/month + 5.5%; Advanced ₹15,000/month + 3.5%; Ultimate ₹30,000/month with zero commission; all + GST.[5]
Check
Custom domain via a ₹24,999 + GST yearly setup; branded apps ₹74,999 + GST setup; a trial is not stated.
Best for
Community-led coaching programmes.

6. Classplus · meets 2 of 5

Good at
A branded teaching app plus website for coaching businesses; "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses".
Published price
₹29,999 for 1 year or ₹39,999 for 2 years.[6]
Check
GST, any fee on sales, renewal price and an iOS app are not stated on the pricing page.
Best for
Coaching institutes selling above about ₹2.3 lakh a year that want one flat price.

7. Teachable (and Kajabi, Thinkific) · meets 2 of 5

Good at
International course platforms; Teachable says "Launch, sell, and scale your online business".
Published price
Teachable Starter $39/month ($29 billed annually) + 7.5%; Builder $89/month ($69) with 0%.[8] Kajabi Basic $179/month ($143 billed annually), 0% revenue share.[9] Thinkific Start $109/month ($82 billed annually).[10] US dollars, excluding Indian GST.
Free trial
Teachable 7 days, Kajabi 14 days, Thinkific 30 days.
Check
Card processing fees and whether Indian students can pay by UPI.
Best for
Educators selling mainly to students abroad.

8. Graphy · meets 1 of 5

Good at
An all-in-one platform for creators: website builder, branded mobile apps, digital products and AI sales agents.
Published price
Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check the page from India. 14-day free trial.[7]
Check
The rupee price, the fee per sale and which plan includes the iOS app.
Best for
Educators selling to a large YouTube or Instagram audience they already have.

9. AppX · meets 1 of 5

Good at
Branded website and apps (Android, iOS, desktop) set up for you; its site says setup takes "under 48 hours" or "3-5 days".
Published price
Not listed on its website (checked 24 Oct 2026); it starts with a free personalised demo.[11]
Check
The yearly cost, any fee on sales and who can change the app after launch.
Best for
Owners who want a done-for-you setup and are comfortable with a sales process.

10. Udemy · meets 1 of 5

Good at
A global course marketplace where instructors publish courses to Udemy's existing learner base.
Published price
Publishing is not a paid plan. Udemy's instructor revenue-share page could not be retrieved on 24 Oct 2026, so we do not quote a percentage.[12]
Check
The current revenue share on Udemy's own support page, and who sets your course price.
Best for
Reaching learners worldwide alongside your own academy, not instead of it.

sections.h2: What changed since last year's list
sections.html:
Three names from our earlier list are gone, because their official websites no longer show a separate course-selling product.

  • Spayee: spayee.com now redirects to graphy.com (checked 24 Oct 2026).[13] Educators who used Spayee should look at Graphy, which is in this list.
  • Teachmint: its website now leads with Teachmint X, an "AI-Powered Connected Classroom Device", and lists no plans or prices; you book a demo.[14] It fits schools and classrooms more than selling courses online.
  • Unacademy: it describes itself as "India's largest online learning platform", but we found no public page for educators to sell their own courses on it.[15]

Kajabi and Thinkific now share a card with Teachable, because all three are US-dollar platforms that suit the same educator. We also removed figures from the earlier version that we could not source, such as estimated first-year costs and migration times.

{{q:Which course selling app brings me students?|Mostly, you bring your own students from YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search, whichever app you choose. Udemy has its own global learner base. AllCoaching also lists your courses on the AllCoaching marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own channels remain the main way students find you.}} {{fig:before-after|Before and after: selling courses through YouTube links, UPI screenshots, WhatsApp notes and Google Forms tests, compared with one course selling app with your own website, Android and iOS app, live classes and UPI checkout|Whichever app you pick, the goal is the same: one place for your courses, students and payments.}}

sections.h2: How to move to a new course selling app without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to change apps is to run both side by side: current students stay where they are until their batch ends, and new admissions go to the new app.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to switch course selling apps: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old plan after the last batch|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Start a free trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with its demo lesson.
Run both apps side by side
Keep current students on the old app until their batch or validity ends, so nobody loses access.
Send new admissions to the new app
Share your own website and app link on WhatsApp, YouTube and Instagram for every new batch.
Export records and close the old plan
Download student and payment records, then let the old plan end at renewal.

faq: What is the best course selling app in India in 2026?

It depends on what you sell. On our five published criteria, AllCoaching ranks first for educators who want their own website and Android and iOS app; Learnyst suits test series, Exly suits selling with nothing upfront, Edmingle suits training businesses with branches and Classplus suits institutes that want one flat yearly price.
Which course selling app costs the least to start?

On published prices, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic have no upfront fee and take 10% of each sale, so they cost least before your first sale. AllCoaching starts with a 14-day free trial with no card, then ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales.
Which course selling app brings me students?

Mostly you bring your own students, whichever app you choose. Udemy has its own global learner base, and AllCoaching lists your courses on its marketplace app as an extra, but YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search stay the main channels.
Should I use Udemy as an Indian educator?
Use it as one channel next to your own academy, not instead of it. Udemy's instructor revenue-share page could not be retrieved on 24 Oct 2026, so check the current share on Udemy's own site.
Are Kajabi, Teachable and Thinkific worth it for Indian educators?
They suit educators selling mainly abroad. They are priced in US dollars: Teachable from $29, Thinkific from $82 and Kajabi from $143 a month billed annually, before Indian GST.
Which course selling app is best for a small coaching institute?

Look for separate teacher logins, batches and your own brand. AllCoaching includes these from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales; Classplus lists one flat ₹29,999 a year; Edmingle suits larger training businesses.
spayee.com now redirects to graphy.com (checked 24 Oct 2026), so we treat former Spayee users as now on Graphy.
Can I try a course selling app before paying?
Yes. AllCoaching gives 14 days with no card, Graphy and Kajabi 14 days, Thinkific 30 days and Teachable 7 days. Exly Starter and TagMango Basic have no upfront fee but take 10% of each sale.
